get.description: Returns status confirming the SPMCIL Tender Monitor server is operational.
Triggers the full scraping cycle across all 12+ sites, synchronizes new and updated tenders, creates corrigendums, and dispatches batch notifications.
Tests connectivity to the PostgreSQL database.

post.description: Authenticates user with email and password, returning a JWT access token.
Validates the user invitation token and sets the initial password.

get.description: Returns profile information for the authenticated JWT user.
Fetches paginated tenders with optional source and unit filtering and flexible sorting.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by source name (e.g., SPMCIL Corporate)

parameters.name: unit_name
parameters.description: Filter by unit name (e.g., CNP Nashik)

get.description: Searches tenders across title, tender number, source, and unit name.
Filters tenders by source, unit, publishing dates, and closing dates.
Fetches all tenders whose closing date has not yet passed.
Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific tender, including corrigendum count, highest risk score, and risk level.
Fetches the full timeline of corrigendums/amendments for a tender, including old vs. new closing dates, categories, risk scores, and detected changes.
Fetches the latest corrigendums across all tenders.
Retrieves specific corrigendum information by ID.
Returns comprehensive statistics, source breakdowns, 7-day activity graphs, recent tenders, and unread notification metrics for the current user.
Lists all in-app notifications for the logged-in user in reverse chronological order.
Quickly returns the count of unread notifications for badge counters.

patch.description: Marks a specific notification as read.
Marks all unread notifications for the current user as read.

get.description: Fetches all tenders bundled inside a specific batch notification.
Retrieves the list of keyword and website preferences saved by the user.

post.description: Registers a new keyword or website preference for automated tender matching.

put.description: Modifies the value of an existing preference.

delete.description: Removes a keyword or website preference.

patch.description: Enables or disables tender matching for this preference without deleting it.

get.description: Lists all system users, roles, statuses, and registration timestamps.

post.description: Generates a 48-hour secure invitation token and sends an onboarding invitation email.
Refreshes the invitation token and re-sends the invitation email to a pending user.

patch.description: Changes user status between ACTIVE, DISABLED, or INVITED.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a user and cascades deletion of their preferences and notifications.

get.description: Returns counts for total users, active users, pending invitations, disabled users, and the 5 most recent invitations.
